newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Jan 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Jan 13.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Bangladeshi knitwear export to Europe faces an uncertain future after an investigation by the Europan Union (EU) revelaed widespread abuse of the GSP (Gneralised System of Preferences) facility.
Speaker Humayun Rashid Chowdhury held a meeting with top opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) leaders on Sunday to break the stalemate in the parliament.
BHP Minerals, an US-Australian multinational, has struck high quality bituminous coal in Bangladesh's northern Dinajpur district.
The government on Sunday approved a proposal for construction of a road-cum-rail bridge over the river Rupsha to connect the Mongla port with the rest of the country.
Opposition BNP Secretary General Abdul Mannan Bhuiyan on Sunday warned that the government's threat to hold byelection would be resisted "at all costs".
Eight developing countries have decided to form a group called D-8 under a cooperative mechanism for creating common platform of development cooperation.
The World Bank is likely to provide Bangladesh between $50 million and $100 million for a project aimed at improving the traffic management in capital Dhaka.
Private spinning mill owners have demanded cash incentive for production of export quality yarn.
